operations.title: Cash payments and refunds
operations.description: Review refund obligations and verify provider results. A refund request does not confirm funds returned.
operations.awaitingConfirmation: Submitted or still processing. Verify the provider result.
operations.failed: The result is unconfirmed. Verify it before continuing.
operations.confirmDispatch: Confirm a {amount} CNY refund through the original payment provider. This returns real funds.
operations.forbidden: You do not have market management permission.
operations.unsupported: Refund dispatch is unavailable for this payment provider.

inProgress: A payment request is being processed. Check again shortly.
closed: This payment is closed. Return to the listing to create a new order.
title: CNY payment
confirm: I confirm the service, delivery time and CNY price.
qrTitle: WeChat payment QR for this order
pending: Payment is not confirmed yet. Check again shortly.
recovery: Payment is confirmed against the payment provider.
notice: CNY and points orders have separate prices. Accept delivery to complete your order.
unavailable: This payment channel is not enabled
error: Unable to complete. Try again shortly.
reconcile: A payment request may already exist. Verify the order first or contact support.
expired: This checkout expired. Contact support before placing a new order.
payout: An order ledger does not prove bank settlement. Creator cash payouts are not enabled.

disputes.title: Order disputes
disputes.description: Review submitted disputes and record your approval reason. Cash refunds enter the refund queue until provider confirmation; points return immediately.
disputes.forbidden: You do not have market management permission.
disputes.confirmCash: Confirm you reviewed this dispute and approve a full refund obligation. This does not confirm funds returned.
disputes.confirmPoints: Confirm you reviewed this dispute and return all points immediately. This changes the real points balance.
disputes.failed: Approval is unconfirmed. Check the order state before retrying.
